Operations and fleet-doctor evidence remain unavailable; no production-readiness or security-clearance claim is supported.

The bounded Save Us Farms public-surface research request is technically feasible and isolated. Approve read-only inspection only; it must not request telemetry, modify production, credentials, configuration, schedules, spending, or tracking, and must not claim revenue, conversion, attribution, readiness, or causal lift.

Retain the CFO report-only finance ledger as a measurement-boundary task. It is feasible with existing authorized evidence, but contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, and forecasts remain unsupported until periods, attribution, and cost sources are aligned. Do not request duplicate telemetry or change billing.
